name: Race (Grand Prix Event)
definition: A single Formula 1 Grand Prix event scheduled within a season, identified by races.raceId. It has an official name, an ordinal round within its season, a hosting circuit and a calendar date.
scope: Race-level analysis: identifying a race by name, by season year, by round, or by its race number.

name: Driver
definition: A person who competes in Formula 1 races, identified by drivers.driverId and described by a reference name, an abbreviated code, a full name, a date of birth and a nationality.
scope: Driver-level analysis: identity, nationality, age, and career results.

name: Constructor (Team)
definition: A Formula 1 team/entrant, identified by constructors.constructorId and described by a name, a reference name, a nationality and a URL.
scope: Team-level analysis: constructor identity, nationality, points and wins.

name: Circuit
definition: A track that hosts Grands Prix, identified by circuits.circuitId and described by a reference name, a name, a location, a country, coordinates and a URL.
scope: Venue-level analysis: where a race was held and where that venue is located.

name: Season (Championship Year)
definition: A Formula 1 championship year, recorded in seasons.year and shared by all races held in that year.
scope: Year-scoped analysis such as season standings or 'from 2007 to 2009'.

name: Race Result (Entry)
definition: The outcome of one driver driving one constructor in one race - one row of the results table, identified by the pair (raceId, driverId), holding grid slot, finishing position, points, laps completed, race time, fastest lap and finishing status.
scope: Per-race performance and classification analysis.

name: Qualifying Result
definition: A driver's qualifying performance for one race - one row of the qualifying table, identified by the pair (raceId, driverId), holding the sequential session times q1, q2 and q3 and the overall qualifying classification position.
scope: Qualifying and grid-position analysis.

name: Lap Record
definition: The timing of one lap by one driver in one race - one row of the lapTimes table, identified by the triple (raceId, driverId, lap), holding the lap ordinal, the position on that lap and the lap duration.
scope: Lap-by-lap timing analysis.

name: Driver Nationality
definition: The sporting nationality recorded for a driver as a demonym string in drivers.nationality.
scope: Nationality filtering and grouping of drivers.

name: Constructor Nationality
definition: The sporting nationality recorded for a constructor as a demonym string in constructors.nationality.
scope: Nationality filtering and grouping of constructors.

name: Circuit Country
definition: The country in which a circuit is located, stored as a plain country name in circuits.country.
scope: Determining the host country of a race through its circuit.

name: Circuit Location
definition: The locality or town in which a circuit sits, stored in circuits.location.
scope: Naming the place where a race was hosted.

name: Race Date
definition: The calendar date on which a race was held, stored in races.date in YYYY-MM-DD form.
scope: Date-scoped race filtering such as 'in September 2005' or 'in 1983/7/16'.

name: Race Name
definition: The official title of a Grand Prix stored in races.name; the same title recurs across seasons and different circuits.
scope: Selecting a Grand Prix by title, such as 'European Grand Prix' or 'Malaysian Grand Prix'.

name: Driver Date of Birth
definition: A driver's date of birth, stored in drivers.dob in YYYY-MM-DD form.
scope: Birth-year filtering and the basis of any age comparison.

name: Result Status
definition: The reason a driver did or did not finish a race, expressed jointly by results.statusId (resolved through status.status) and results.positionText.
scope: Interpreting finishes, retirements and failed qualifying attempts.

name: Race Completion
definition: Whether a race entry completed the race; in this dataset an entry counts as completed when its results.time is populated.
scope: Completion rates and 'finished the race' filters.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: The complete personal name of a driver, formed from drivers.forename followed by drivers.surname; no single column stores it.
scope: Matching a driver named in natural language to a driver record.

name: Driver Reference Name
definition: The short machine-readable identifier of a driver stored as a lowercase slug in drivers.driverRef.
scope: Returning or matching a driver by the 'reference name' asked for in a question.

name: Driver Code
definition: The three-letter abbreviated driver code stored in drivers.code, for example HAM.
scope: Returning or matching a driver by an 'abbreviated code'.

name: Circuit Reference Name
definition: The short machine-readable identifier of a circuit stored in circuits.circuitRef.
scope: Returning a circuit by the 'reference name' asked for in a question.

name: Constructor Reference Name
definition: The short machine-readable identifier of a constructor stored in constructors.constructorRef.
scope: Returning a constructor by the 'reference name' asked for in a question.

name: Circuit Coordinates
definition: The geographic position of a circuit expressed as latitude in circuits.lat and longitude in circuits.lng.
scope: Answering for the coordinates or position of a circuit.

name: Reference URL
definition: An external reference URL, typically a Wikipedia page, carried on drivers, constructors and circuits.
scope: Answering for the website of a driver, constructor or circuit.

name: Points
definition: Championship points, available both as points scored by one entry in one race and as a cumulative championship total after a race.
scope: Scoring, zero-point and maximum-point analysis for drivers and constructors.

name: Wins
definition: The number of race victories, available as a cumulative season count or derived by counting first-place finishes.
scope: Most-winning and victory-count analysis.

name: Finishing Position
definition: The classified finishing position of a driver in a race, held in results.position (equivalent to results.positionOrder); 1 means the entry won the race.
scope: Ranking race outcomes and locating a driver's best or worst result.

name: Championship Position
definition: A driver's or constructor's position in the championship standings after a given race, held in driverStandings.position and constructorStandings.position.
scope: Standings analysis and identifying the season champion.

name: Race Total Time
definition: The elapsed race time recorded for a race entry; only for the race winner is it the total race duration rather than a gap.
scope: Identifying the winner from the recorded time, and reading a race's duration.

name: Lap Time
definition: The duration of a single lap by a driver in a race, held numerically in lapTimes.milliseconds and as text in lapTimes.time.
scope: Lap-duration comparison, averaging and thresholds.

name: Fastest Lap Time
definition: The shortest lap time recorded by a driver in a race, stored per entry in results.fastestLapTime and derivable as the minimum of that entry's lap durations.
scope: Fastest-lap questions and fastest-lap ranking.

name: Fastest Lap Number
definition: The lap ordinal, lapTimes.lap, at which a driver's fastest lap of a race was set.
scope: Answering for the lap number of a fastest lap.
aliases: lap number of the fastest lap

name: Race Lap Count
definition: The number of laps a driver completed in a race, stored in results.laps.
scope: Lap-count thresholds such as 'lap numbers were over 50'.

name: Lap Number
definition: The ordinal position of a lap within a race, lapTimes.lap, running from 1 to the race distance.
scope: Locating a specific lap within a race.

name: Qualifying Time
definition: The lap time a driver set in one qualifying segment, held in qualifying.q1, qualifying.q2 and qualifying.q3.
scope: Qualifying-time comparison and thresholds within a segment.

name: Qualifying Position
definition: A driver's overall qualifying classification for a race, held in qualifying.position, where 1 means pole position.
scope: Identifying the fastest qualifier or a driver's grid classification.

name: Driver Age
definition: A driver's age, which is not stored and must be derived from drivers.dob relative to a reference date.
scope: Youngest and oldest driver analysis.

name: Race Winner
definition: The driver classified first in a race, that is the entry with results.position = 1.
scope: Race-winner questions, including questions that call this driver the race champion.

name: Season Champion
definition: The driver or constructor holding championship position 1 in the standings after the final race of a season.
scope: Season title questions scoped to a championship year.

name: Race Completion Rate
definition: The proportion of race entries in scope that were completed, expressed as a percentage.
scope: Completion-percentage questions over a driver group, a race or a period.
